NEW src/db/migrations/018-durable-dispatch-and-harvest.sql. Create dispatch and attempt tables plus delivery, cursor and outbox stage tables

REVIEW FAIL (code): Outbox uniqueness is missing after ledger upgrade — FR-004.
  WHERE: src/db/migrations/018-durable-dispatch-and-harvest.sql:145-169, src/db/index.ts:96-129
  EXPECTED: Reopening a ledger created with the pre-Phase 02 migration enforces UNIQUE(client_metadata_key), as a fresh ledger does.
  ACTUAL: The migration runner skips the already recorded 018 filename. The reopened ledger has no unique index on client_metadata_key. The fresh ledger has one.
  FIX: Add a forward migration that enforces global metadata-key uniqueness while preserving outbox rows. Gate an upgrade from the pre-Phase 02 schema and assert that a duplicate key across projects fails.

tasks.title: Create operations.ts
tasks.description:
NEW src/db/operations.ts. Implement transactional acceptance and fenced leases plus stage receipts, cursors and outbox reads. Tests: src/db/operations.test.ts

REVIEW FAIL (code): Harvest intake commits partial writes on conflict and drops enriched terminalAt — FR-002.
  WHERE: src/db/operations.ts:177-357,696-834
  EXPECTED: Run mutating store calls inside .immediate() transactions. Roll back the entire batch when any scope returns HARVEST_IDENTITY_MISMATCH on an operation_id collision, a work_key alias conflict or conflicting verified head facts. Persist enriched terminal_at in UPDATE harvest_operations.
  ACTUAL: recordHarvestIntake returns { ok: false, code: "HARVEST_IDENTITY_MISMATCH" } from db.transaction() without throwing, so better-sqlite3 commits earlier phase rows and aliases without a delivery row. matchHarvestScope updates existing.terminalAt in memory on line 288 while UPDATE harvest_operations on lines 329-354 omits terminal_at = ?. Line 268 uses INSERT OR IGNORE on harvest_work_key_aliases without checking conflicting work keys across both tables.
  FIX: Wrap store mutators in .immediate() transactions and roll back via a caught internal error before returning { ok: false }. Check project_id and work_key across harvest_operations and harvest_work_key_aliases before inserting, and include terminal_at = ? in UPDATE harvest_operations. Gate multi-phase rollback and enriched terminalAt persistence across reopen in src/db/operations.test.ts.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Dispatch lease fencing skips expiry and terminal guards and omits reconciling recovery — FR-001.
  WHERE: src/db/operations.ts:441-448,551-655,837-852
  EXPECTED: completeDispatchAttempt validates the active lease with validateLeaseFence and rejects terminal operations. Terminal transitions clear lease_owner, lease_expires_at and heartbeat_at. listRecoverableDispatches and claimDispatchLease recover expired reconciling rows and null-expiry leased rows using Date.parse timestamp comparison.
  ACTUAL: completeDispatchAttempt checks only owner and epoch, so it accepts expired leases instead of returning LEASE_EXPIRED. It leaves lease_owner and lease_expires_at populated on completed rows, allowing a duplicate call or heartbeat to mutate terminal state. claimDispatchLease and listRecoverableDispatches omit reconciling from idx_dispatch_operations_active_work_key and compare lease_expires_at with SQLite text <= instead of Date.parse.
  FIX: Call validateLeaseFence in completeDispatchAttempt and require an active leased, running or reconciling status. Clear lease_owner, lease_expires_at and heartbeat_at on terminal updates. Include reconciling and null-expiry leased rows in claimDispatchLease and listRecoverableDispatches, and evaluate Date.parse(leaseExpiresAt) <= Date.parse(nowIso) in dispatch and harvest recovery queries. Gate expired-lease completion, post-completion immutability and reconciling recovery in src/db/operations.test.ts.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Enrolled binding lookup, outbox claim predicate and status aggregation misreport state — FR-003.
  WHERE: src/db/operations.ts:967-999,1445-1450,1503-1519,1722-1822
  EXPECTED: initializeHarvestStages reads Slack bindings only from enrolled projects with updated_at IS NOT NULL. claimOutboxItem guards its UPDATE with current status and attempt_count. getOperationsStatus reports pendingStages only for non-terminal harvests using s.phase_key, includes sending rows in unresolved delivery metrics and scopes legacyUnverifiedRuns across projectScope(db, projectId).
  ACTUAL: initializeHarvestStages queries SELECT * FROM projects WHERE id = ? without updated_at IS NOT NULL and reads retired local rows. claimOutboxItem updates WHERE outbox_id = ? without status or attempt_count predicates. getOperationsStatus includes pending stages from terminal gate_failed harvests and reports h.phase_id instead of s.phase_key. It also drops status = 'sending' outbox rows from all delivery counts and queries runs WHERE r.project_id = ? without project_aliases.
  FIX: Require updated_at IS NOT NULL and matching workspace and channel when resolving Slack bindings and threads in initializeHarvestStages. Guard claimOutboxItem updates with status and attempt_count and check res.changes. Filter pendingStages by resumable harvest status and derive phaseId from s.phase_key. Surface sending outbox rows in delivery counts and use projectScope(db, projectId) for legacyUnverifiedRuns and canonical local_root lookup. Gate each case in src/db/operations.test.ts.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Biome lint check fails with 52 errors including 13 explicit any types — FR-006.
  WHERE: src/db/operations.ts:64-1802, src/db/operations.test.ts:15-20,471-764, src/db/db.test.ts:14-49,1783-1791, specs/049-durable-dispatch-harvest/gates/phase-02.sh:1-8
  EXPECTED: pnpm lint exits 0 with typed SQLite row interfaces in src/db/operations.ts and clean formatting across Phase 2 files. gates/phase-02.sh enforces Biome checks on Phase 2 files.
  ACTUAL: pnpm lint exits 1 with 52 errors across src/db/operations.ts, src/db/operations.test.ts and src/db/db.test.ts. Those errors include 13 lint/suspicious/noExplicitAny violations and 34 lint/style/noUnusedTemplateLiteral violations.
  FIX: Replace every any in src/db/operations.ts with explicit row and parameter types. Fix unused template literals, import sorting and formatting across src/db/operations.ts, src/db/operations.test.ts and src/db/db.test.ts so pnpm lint passes, and add Biome check coverage to specs/049-durable-dispatch-harvest/gates/phase-02.sh.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Matched harvest work rejects a provisional ID collision — FR-002.
  WHERE: src/db/operations.ts:393-424
  EXPECTED: Resolve an out-of-order close to the saved merge before matching work keys. Keep the saved operation ID for any match. Check global operation ID uniqueness only for inserts.
  ACTUAL: The store checks the proposed ID after finding a match. A poll delivery for PR 42 returned HARVEST_IDENTITY_MISMATCH when its proposed ID belonged to PR 43. A later close for PR 42 failed the same way. Neither delivery received a link to the saved merge.
  FIX: Resolve stale closes before work-key matching. Move the global ID check inside the insert branch. Add phase gate cases for both matched deliveries and retain the rollback case for an actual insert collision.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Stale poll results rewind the harvest cursor — FR-002.
  WHERE: src/db/operations.ts:2013-2030
  EXPECTED: Keep the newest committed polling watermark and its associated last PR number when an older poll finishes later.
  ACTUAL: The ON CONFLICT update copies all cursor fields from excluded. A stale save moved the terminal watermark back ten minutes. It changed the last PR number from 45 to 41.
  FIX: Compare cursor timestamps by instant in the immediate transaction. Preserve the saved terminal watermark and PR number when a stale result arrives. Add a phase gate case with two connections and an older poll saving last.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Historical dispatch counts omit single-task records — FR-006.
  WHERE: src/db/operations.ts:220-250,2179-2194
  EXPECTED: Count valid historical taskId records and current tasks array records as legacy_unverified in both store entry points.
  ACTUAL: The fallback validator requires Array.isArray(record.tasks). The store with the injected reader also undercounts. Both counted one record in a file with one valid record of each shape.
  FIX: Share the historical dispatch decoder with the injected reader and fallback. Add a phase gate case that checks the count through both entry points.

Move the global `operation_id` lookup inside `if (!existing)`, immediately before the insert. Return the saved operation for both match paths so intake links the delivery to its saved ID. Keep `HARVEST_IDENTITY_MISMATCH` and full batch rollback for an actual insert collision.
FIX: src/db/operations.ts — In `saveHarvestCursor`, read `HarvestCursorRow` inside the existing `.immediate()` transaction. Compare timestamps with `Date.parse`. Advance `lastTerminalAt` and `lastPrNumber` together only when the incoming terminal instant is newer or first non-null. Update `lastPolledAt` and `lastError` together only when the poll instant advances.
FIX: src/domain/legacy-dispatch.ts — Add a pure `decodeLegacyDispatchLine(line: string): LegacyDispatchPayload | null`. Define `LegacyDispatchPayload` as shared fields with an `attempts` array plus either a nonblank `taskId: string` or a `tasks` array. Require a plain object, nonblank `id`, `featureId`, `phaseId`, `backend`, `branchName`, and `createdAt`, and a status of `queued`, `running`, `completed`, `failed`, or `retrying`. Preserve the original fields.
FIX: src/server/persistence.ts — Replace `isDispatchRecord` with `decodeLegacyDispatchLine` from `../domain/legacy-dispatch.js`. Define `LegacyDispatchRecord` as `LegacyDispatchPayload & { evidenceLevel: "legacy_unverified" }`. Tag decoded records and retain the read-only missing-file behavior. Keep `persistDispatch` typed to `DispatchRecord`.
FIX: src/db/operations.ts — Import `decodeLegacyDispatchLine` from `../domain/legacy-dispatch.js` and replace `isLegacyDispatchLine` with a count of successfully decoded fallback JSONL lines. Keep the injected `readLegacyDispatches` path and canonical project root lookup.
FIX: src/db/operations.test.ts — Add a PR 42 poll and a stale close whose proposed operation ID belongs to PR 43. Assert both deliveries succeed, link to the saved PR 42 merge, and replay the same link. Cover stale-close precedence with a conflicting close work-key alias. Retain the existing batch rollback case for a real insert collision.
FIX: src/db/operations.test.ts — Open two connections to the same ledger. Save the newer cursor with PR 45 first, then save an older cursor with PR 41 using offsets that reverse lexical order. Assert the saved poll time, terminal watermark, and PR 45 survive. Cover a null terminal watermark and a subsequent newer watermark.
FIX: src/db/operations.test.ts — Add a pre-`75c99d1c` fixture with `taskId: "T001"` and `attempts: []` alongside the parallel record and malformed lines. Assert the reader preserves `taskId` and tags both records `legacy_unverified`. Assert the injected and fallback stores each report two records. Retain the missing `.gwrk` non-mutation assertion.
FIX: specs/049-durable-dispatch-harvest/gates/phase-02.sh — Keep the existing `pnpm lint` and `src/db/operations.test.ts` gate entries. Run the new cases before production edits and confirm they reproduce the diagnosed failures. After the fixes, run the full Phase 2 gate and `specs/049-durable-dispatch-harvest/gates/phase-01.sh`.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Dispatch recovery reverses FIFO order for offset timestamps — FR-001.
  WHERE: src/db/operations.ts:809-826,2031-2035
  EXPECTED: A dispatch accepted at 13:00+02:00 precedes one accepted at 12:00Z on the same date. Queue status reports the first dispatch as oldest.
  ACTUAL: ORDER BY created_at and MIN(created_at) compare text. Recovery returned the 12:00Z dispatch first and status reported it as oldest.
  FIX: Compare creation timestamps by instant in recovery order and queue status. Preserve deterministic ties. Add an offset fixture to the Phase 02 gate.

REVIEW FAIL (code): Harvest retry receipts persist zero attempts — FR-003.
  WHERE: src/db/operations.ts:1276-1289,1479-1507
  EXPECTED: Starting git_sync, recording retryable_failure, and running git_sync under the next lease leaves attemptCount at two.
  ACTUAL: Initialization writes attempt_count = 0. Stage transitions omit the field. The next claim returned a succeeded receipt with attemptCount: 0.
  FIX: Update attempt_count in the fenced stage transaction when a new execution starts. Preserve it through outcomes and repeated writes for the same attempt. Gate retry and recovery across lease epochs.
